name: CheckUnmanagedLayers
description: Checks for unmanaged layers on components of a managed Dataverse solution. Fails the pipeline if unmanaged customizations are detected.
helpMarkDown: This task queries the Dataverse Web API to detect unmanaged layers on solution components. Unmanaged layers indicate customizations made outside of solution management that can cause issues during deployments.
author: aschwarzdynpro

inputs.name: authenticationType
inputs.label: Authentication Type
inputs.helpMarkDown: Select the authentication method for connecting to Dataverse.

inputs.name: dataverseUrl
inputs.label: Dataverse Environment URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: The URL of the Dataverse environment (e.g. https://yourorg.crm.dynamics.com).

inputs.name: clientId
inputs.label: Client ID (Application ID)
inputs.helpMarkDown: The Azure AD Application (Client) ID registered for Dataverse access.

inputs.name: clientSecret
inputs.label: Client Secret
inputs.helpMarkDown: The client secret for the Azure AD application.

inputs.name: password
inputs.label: Password
inputs.helpMarkDown: The password for the Dataverse user account.

inputs.name: solutionUniqueName
inputs.label: Solution Unique Name
inputs.helpMarkDown: The unique name of the Dataverse solution to check for unmanaged layers (e.g. MyCompanySolution).

inputs.name: failOnUnmanagedLayers
inputs.label: Fail pipeline if unmanaged layers are found
inputs.helpMarkDown: If enabled, the pipeline task will fail when unmanaged layers are detected. If disabled, only a warning is shown.

inputs.name: outputFormat
inputs.label: Output Format
inputs.helpMarkDown: How the results should be displayed in the pipeline output.
